title: Healing Arabian Lentil Tagine
description: A winey, springy lentil tagine that balances sweet treacle and bright spices, ideal for curing hangovers and soothing the soul.

ingredients.name: spice blend
ingredients.notes: cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, cinnamon, turmeric, ginger, saffron

instructions: Heat olive oil in a tagine or heavy pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion, minced garlic, and sliced carrot; sauté until onions are translucent.
Stir in chopped tomatoes and the spice blend, cooking for 2 minutes to bloom flavors.
Add the red lentils, chickpeas, and red wine, stirring to combine and deglaze the pot.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 20 minutes until lentils are tender.
Warm the treacle until liquid, then stir it into the tagine, letting the dish finish cooking for an additional 5 minutes.
Fold in the spinach, allowing it to wilt while retaining its bright color.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, serve hot over couscous or flatbread if desired.
